purpose: Revalidate the post-refactor mini-swe-agent result, repeat the same logical treatment across agents, and test model sensitivity without changing the selector.

task_cohort.rule: No outcome-dependent task replacement. A selective arm is scored only when its contemporaneous FULL control resolves officially.

logical_policy.supersedes: Legacy matched-tail runs whose labels recorded H2/T4 although the materializer did not consume those floors.

requirements: Every FULL repeat resolves officially before treatment.
The treatment preserves every eligible official resolution.
Aggregate treatment calls do not exceed the paired FULL-A calls.
Own-trajectory omission remains positive and is reported beside the historical 11.68 percent rather than forced to equal it.
Any configuration, tokenizer, model-digest, workspace, or submission-protocol mismatch fails the comparison before outcome analysis.

agent_replication.comparison_rule: Keep the model, tokenizer, task, policy, generation controls, and official grader fixed. Normalize only native events into the common record contract.
agent_replication.accounting_rule: Token totals and savings are paired within agent. Compare official resolution, normalized actions, calls to solution, own-trajectory saving, and paired saving across agents; never pool raw prompt-token totals across different agent schemas.
agent_replication.admission_rule: Run FULL first for every agent/task identity. Do not launch or score the selective arm after a failed FULL control.

model_replication.stage_1: At identical frozen successful decision points, compare FULL and the frozen selected history for valid action, target resource, semantic action equivalence, and first divergence.
model_replication.stage_2: For each model, run autonomous FULL admission on the locked tasks. Run the frozen selective policy only on that model's FULL-success identities.
model_replication.interpretation: Frozen replay tests selector sensitivity to model choice; autonomous paired runs test realized task quality. Neither substitutes for the other.

supersession.reason: The first exact Pi transfer showed that generic tail-line rewriting of an oversized source view is not a safe cross-agent operation and cannot map to resident K/V omission.
